title: Character
description: A character in a Role Playing Game.

type.description: The type of thingy the data describes, 'character'.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the schema for the data.

playerName.description: The name of the player of the character.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.description: A list of campaign IDs this character is in.

items.title: Campaign ID
items.description: The IDs of the campaigns the character is in.

description.description: The description of the character, Markdown allowed.

characterType.title: Character type
characterType.description: The type of character, PC, NPC, Mob, Ship, etc.

refresh.description: The current minimum number of Fate points the player of this character starts with at the beginning of a session.

fatePoints.description: The current number of Fate points the player of this character currently has.

images.description: A list of images representing the character, to be included on the character's sheet.
images.title: Character Images

caption.description: The caption to be displayed with the image.
caption.title: Image Caption

traitType.description: The type of the properties of the character used as a bonus on a dice roll to resolve actions.

name.description: The name of the trait, like 'Notice', 'Careful', or 'Warrior'

rank.description: The bonus applied to a resolution roll when this trait is applicable.

stunts.description: A list of the stunts the character can use.

tracks.description: The data structures used to track the current state of the character.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Section for notes about the character

items.description: A line of a multi-text notes field. Supports Markdown

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Arbitrary tags to be applied to the character.

items.title: Tag
items.description: A tag that applies to a character.

extras.description: A list of extras that do not fit into any other category on the character. Each Extra can include multiple Tracks, Aspects (including character aspects), or Traits

description.description: A description of the Aspect, giving a little more context, Markdown allowed.

freeInvokes.description: How many Free Invokes are currently on the Aspect

trackId.description: A unique identifier for this track on the character to which it is tied.

trackLabel.description: The label or title for this track.

showSoakAmount.description: Should the amount of soak the boxes in this track be displayed to the user?

characterReference.description: The ID of a different character to which this track applies.

isUsed.description: Has the box been used to soak shifts of effect?

soakValue.description: How many shifts of effect the box can soak.

extra.description: An "Extra", a group of things about a character that do not fit into any other category.

description.description: The description of the extra. Markdown allowed.
